description: Save a current public product in this buyer's favorites, without adding it to the basket. Use get_favorites to inspect the saved list or remove_favorite to undo; use add_cart_item for a purchase basket. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

product_id.description: Internal numeric Vesremont product ID returned by catalog search or a product response, not the SKU/article or a basket item ID.

name: add_favorite
